Loss of Psmd13 primarily impairs proteasome activity, which can trigger general stress responses (e.g., UPR/ISR, p53 stabilization) and alter NF‑κB signaling, but there is no documented direct or indirect pathway linking Psmd13 deficiency to transcriptional activation or repression of the Trappc9 promoter in BMDMs. Consequently, the evidence is insufficient to assign a reproducible up‑ or down‑regulation.
